question: What happens when add() runs?
options: It re-renders and shows a, b
It does not re-render because the array reference did not change
explanation: React compares the new state with Object.is. Mutating the array and passing the same reference skips the render. Use setItems([...items, 'b']) instead.

question: What happens when the user clicks this button?

question: In a repo with earlier commits, what does git status show for index.html after these commands?
code:
git add index.html
git commit -m "add page"
git reset --soft HEAD~1
git status
options: Nothing to commit, working tree clean
explanation: reset --soft moves HEAD back one commit but keeps the changes staged, so index.html shows under Changes to be committed.
